body: four notches on the garden hoe match four marks on the camera; a fifth mark was sanded flat on both.
title: Garden hoe beside the spare mark
gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

body:
You said one bite was enough, so I marked the water barrel too. The field crew calls the rinse routine; I still will not let the dog drink until the tank is flushed.

I thought the date would settle it. When I asked, the person at the barrier looked at the seal instead and handed it back.

I wrote the time before I went back for the others. The clock may have been slow; the second vehicle was already gone.
title: A corner still legible
gloss: A family water warning follows a field crew rinse and leaves the source uncertain.
rival_reading: A containment crew could have rinsed a trailer tank during cleanup; the warning does not establish what caused the danger.
